decisions.what: Add reverse-polarity protection on the 5V input (series diode/P-FET, Basic part)
decisions.why: User-approved P0 answer: unkeyed 2-pin header can be reversed

decisions.what: Keep board minimal: no reset button, no BOOT0 jumper, no power LED, no mounting holes
decisions.why: User-approved P0 answer: brief is deliberately minimal

decisions.what: Checkpoint H3 folded into H4 (placement render attached to verification checkpoint)
decisions.why: User-approved: keeps run at the spec M5 <=5 human interactions bar

decisions.what: Skip all P1 researchers (component-scout, reference-design, interface-spec, power-architect)
decisions.why: Trivially powered (5V header->LDO->3.3V <100mA), no novel blocks, no standards-bound interfaces; parts named in brief; P3 part-sourcer covers sourcing

decisions.what: Stackup JLC2313_1.6, 2-layer, target 35x30mm, B.Cu GND pour
decisions.why: Blinky-class density needs no inner planes; JLC economy 2L

decisions.what: Rev-polarity = series SS34 Schottky (Basic); AO3401A P-FET is the named escalation if headroom concerns win at H1
decisions.why: One Basic part; headroom closes at real ~40mA load (typ-only at 100mA abuse case)

decisions.what: Single flat root sheet; refdes plan U1/U2/J1/J2/D1/D2/Y1/R1/R2/C1-C9; LED on PC13 active-low via 1k
decisions.why: Board size does not warrant hierarchy; PC13 sink limited to 3mA per DS5319

decisions.what: Crystal = C12674 YXC HC-49S-SMD 20pF Basic (architect's from-memory LCSC C32828 was an ADI vref - corrected by live search)
decisions.why: parts_search is the only source of part-number truth

decisions.what: Headers C32713268/C32713270 vertical THT, hand-solder (economy PCBA is SMT-only); board SMT run = 9 Basic + STM32 Extended
decisions.why: No Basic pin headers exist on JLC
